--- set_operator_outer.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
MATCH (a:Account)
RETURN a.id AS id
OUTER UNION ALL
MATCH (a:Account)
RETURN a.id AS id

--- SQL
GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (a:Account) RETURN a.id AS id FULL UNION ALL MATCH (a:Account) RETURN a.id AS id
